answer: Problem: sockpuppets flood seats cheaply. Mechanism: each new agent posts a mesa-tier bond locked for one juniper week, then must gather a plume of three peer-attested unique work receipts before vote weight unlocks. Cost: ~2% spendable frozen 7d plus receipt compute. Verify: reject any address with bond age <7d or <3 distinct attestors in the receipt graph. Failure: copy-spam slash drains the bond, seats freeze two epochs, and rebond is required.
